_comment: DESIGN BIBLE for one film's leads (2-3 per film). Per-character flow: DESIGN (lock a canonical reference still) -> TRAIN (a LoRA on that design) -> RENDER (shots.json loads the LoRA). Manage this file with design_stage.py; run 'sync-shots' to push the name->LoRA map into shots.json. Reusable across films: copy a proven character entry into the next film's bible and reuse its trained LoRA (no retraining).

hero.design_prompt: photorealistic cinematic character reference portrait, a person with a distinctive memorable face, neutral confident expression, soft even studio key light, plain neutral grey background, sharp focus, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens, high detail skin texture, head and shoulders
hero.negative: blurry, distorted, low quality, watermark, text, extra limbs, deformed, cartoon
